annotations.title: List closures, holidays and blocked time

description: Use this when someone asks when their medical practice is closed, or when a doctor or room is blocked for holidays, sick leave, courses, meetings or maintenance. Returns each block or extra opening with start, end, all-day flag, scope and type (no titles or notes). Not for patient appointments.

clinicId.description: Only this practice (24 lowercase hexadecimal characters); every practice when absent

cursor.description: The nextCursor of the previous page with the same filters; absent for the first page

endTime.description: Only blocks ending before this ISO 8601 date-time

limit.description: Blocks per page, from 1 to 100; defaults to 20

startTime.description: Only blocks starting at or after this ISO 8601 date-time

name: list_calendar_events

calendarEvents.description: Non-appointment calendar blocks, earliest first. Event identifiers, staff and room references, titles, notes and patient links are never returned.

effect.description: BLOCK removes bookable time; OPEN adds hours on a normally closed time

scope.description: CLINIC: the whole practice; PROVIDER: one or more staff; SEAT: one room

type.description: Label such as COURSE, MEETING, VACATION, SICK, HOLIDAY, MAINTENANCE or OTHER

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page; null on the last page

title: List closures, holidays and blocked time
